purpose: Teach: 車検/よき/よん/缶詰/立ち読み/度々/あした/嫌がらせ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お父さんの車、車検、自分で、調べたって、すごいよね、結構、勉強したんだね、本当に。
lines.en: Riku, it's amazing that you looked up your dad's car inspection yourself. You really studied it up.
lines.style: Warm admiration with a hint of teasing affection. Bright attack. Genuine underneath the casual delivery. Leans into the praise without making it awkward.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。よき指導者、出会えるって、本当に、人生で、大事なことだよな、桜、お互いに、感謝、しないとね。
lines.en: Yeah. Meeting a good mentor really is one of the important things in life, isn't it? We should thank each other, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity breaking through. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft conviction on the word 'important.' Not performing depth—just saying what he means.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日、よん時間目、自習だったよね、リク、ラッキーだったわよね、結構、宿題、進んだわ、私。
lines.en: Today's fourth period was self-study, right? You were lucky. I got a lot of homework done.
lines.style: Light, conversational brightness. No weight to it. Quick pace, easy rhythm. The tone of someone sharing a small good moment without needing fanfare.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活前、缶詰のスナック、結構、お腹、満たせるんだぜ、桜、お前も、試してみるか?
lines.en: Before club practice, canned snacks actually fill you up pretty well. You want to try some?
lines.style: Casual offer with a wry undertone. Slight shrug in the voice. Practical suggestion without being preachy. Comfortable silence between the words.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 駅前の書店で、立ち読みしてて、お母さんに、見つかって、ちょっと、怒られちゃったよ、私、リク、笑える?
lines.en: I was browsing at the bookstore near the station and my mom caught me. She got a little mad. Riku, isn't that kind of funny?
lines.style: Playful self-deprecation with the hurt underneath showing through. Slight laugh in the voice on the setup. Seeking his permission to laugh at herself. Hopeful at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 最近、度々、お前と、勉強できて、本当に、はかどってるぜ、桜、感謝してる、いつも、本当に。
lines.en: Lately I've been able to study with you really often, and it's really helping. I'm grateful, Sakura. Really grateful.
lines.style: Earnest and unguarded. Steady delivery, no rush. Slight vulnerable tremor on the second 'grateful' as if admitting something. Not shy—just sincere.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あした、私たち、試験だよね、リク、お互い、頑張ろうね、結果、本当に、楽しみだよ、ね。
lines.en: We've got the test tomorrow, right? Let's both do our best. I'm really looking forward to seeing how we do.
lines.style: Bright forward-looking energy. Quick, encouraging pace. Genuine excitement without artifice. The slight vulnerability of hoping they both succeed together.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: クラスで、嫌がらせ、絶対、許さないよな、桜、お前、悪口とか、聞いたら、すぐ、教えて、ね、お互いに。
lines.en: If anyone bullies you or says anything bad about you in class, tell me right away, okay? We've got each other.
lines.style: Protective but not overbearing. Soft, steady delivery. Firmness underneath—not anger, just resolve. Closes quiet and close, like a promise.
